summary: Request for timeboxed privileged extraction of customer PII logs for regulatory verification
description:
Issue summary:
Legal has received a regulator request to verify deletion and handling of a small customer's PII for a compliance audit. The request requires a timeboxed, read-only extraction of production request logs and associated KV-cache traces tied to a single customer_id to confirm deletion timestamps and downstream propagation.

Impact:
- Internal only: will involve privileged access to prod logs. No new feature work.
- Risk: accidental broader access if query scope is incorrect; PII exposure if export not handled securely.

Environment:
- prod cluster: us-east, prod-rtg-02 serving-runtime nodes.
- Affected artifacts: request logs (s3://redwood-prod-logs/requests/), KV-cache debug excerpts, and audit logs.

Request details / Acceptance criteria:
1) Scoped export containing only records where customer_id = "cust_9x7f" and timestamp range 2025-11-01..2026-02-28.
2) Export must be done by an approved engineer using a temporary role (timebox: 72 hours) created via IAM workflow.
3) Export file encrypted with customer-specific KMS key and stored in an access-controlled long-term location for Legal (ttl: 90 days).
4) Every access to the extraction must be logged and a short memo produced for the regulator.

Steps to reproduce / runbook excerpt:
1) Approver (Security) issues ephemeral_role via identity-service with scope: read-only logs, filter predicate by customer_id.
2) SRE runs a scoped query using the standard log-export script: infra/tools/log-export --tenant cust_9x7f --start 2025-11-01 --end 2026-02-28 --destination s3://redwood-compliance-exports/INT-9927/ --encrypt-with KMS:cust-9x7f-key --dry-run.
3) Legal reviews dry-run manifest, then approves full export.

Logs / Evidence links:
- Kibana dashboard: https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/discover#/?_g=()&_a=(index:%27prod-requests-*%27,query:(query_string:(query:'customer_id: cust_9x7f')))
comments: Priya Shah (2026-03-10): Opening ticket on behalf of Legal. Regulator gave a formal written request attached to email thread. Need security approval and SRE execution. Prefer result by 2026-03-15 due to audit window.
Ethan Morales (2026-03-10): Assigned. Adding SRE runbook steps. Will need Security to create ephemeral role and confirm KMS key availability. Marking as P1 because of regulator timeline.

Samantha Lin - Security (2026-03-11): Security reviewed initial scope. Need clarification: will export include full request payloads (may contain model outputs) or only headers/metadata? We prefer payload redaction unless explicitly required.

Priya Shah (2026-03-11): Regulator specifically requested deletion verification timestamps and example request entries (payload not strictly required except where deletion claim references specific outputs). Legal prefers minimal payload; metadata + timestamps should suffice for most records.
Attached: regulator_request_2026-03-09.pdf

Ethan Morales (2026-03-12): Per Security guidance, we will run dry-run export with metadata-only. If regulator requests payload samples, Legal will re-open request and we will require an additional approval step. Preparing IAM ticket for ephemeral role (INT-9930).
investigation_notes:
Hypotheses considered: (1) Records exist but deletion markers not propagated to downstream analytics buckets; (2) Deletion completed but search index still returns stale hits due to cache TTL; (3) Customer had multiple IDs - need to confirm canonical mapping.
Findings so far:
- Quick query against prod-requests-* shows deletion event entries for cust_9x7f with deletion_timestamp fields present for ~92% of records.
- A subset (~8%) show no deletion_timestamp; those records map to older API keys created before 2025-06 and may be under a different customer alias (cust_alias_23).
- Related dashboards: observability/alerts/DELTA-deletion-coverage (investigate alias mapping).
Next steps:
- Security to provision ephemeral_role (72h).
- SRE to run metadata-only dry-run and share manifest with Legal.
- Data team to run alias-resolution script and produce mapping (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/data-tools/pull/489).
resolution: Pending security approval and ephemeral role creation. If approved: SRE will perform metadata-only export (encrypted), Legal will deliver to regulator with memo. Follow-up: if regulator requests payload samples, reopen with explicit scope and additional controls (HSM-wrapped keys, access audit by third-party).
audit_log_requirements: All actions performing the export must be recorded in identity-service logs and stored in audit S3 prefix s3://redwood-audit/ephemeral-access/INT-9927/. Include operator principal, time, and exact CLI command. Security to confirm retention policy (default: 365 days).
